sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the low pressure 
feed water pump general nspection steps I2, which must be carried out when there is 
abnormal sound in the pump and high vibration on bearings or discharge pressure < 
9.5 bar at max. flow of the pump.

Dismantling
ملحوظة:

This operation is 
 exceptional and should be carried out only in case of trouble occurring in 
 pump itself, or in case of maintenance inspection. It requires complete 
 motor-pump disassembling. Perform it in works.
Generates

Refer to 
 sectional drawing of pump.
افصل التيار الكهربائي عن المحرك.
Close valves on suction and discharge to isolate pump.
Drain pump casing (Plug 831) and turn on the drain valve (Item 6) of bearing.
Disconnect available auxiliary piping (cooling - manometer).
Remove the protector cover and mattress with care.
Remove the coupling guard and spacer parts (1),
Release the bearing support foot (2).
Let the pump casing remains fixed to the base plate and to its piping.
Impeller inspection

Dismantle the bearing 
 housing by unscrewing the bolts that hold the seal 
 box and the pump casing.

Remove 
 assembly (rotor, sealing box, bearing) from pump casing (3) (Operation 
 facilitated by using jack screws).

Unscrew the impeller nut 
 (Item 430), rotation opposite to the rotation of the pump.

Withdraw tab washer 
 (Item 4308).

Remove the impeller 
 (Item 200) and key (440).

sections.text: Reassembling
Generalities

If the disassembly has 
 been done with care, (without shock and parts well 
 referenced) the reassemble does not present any difficulties.

All parts must be 
 carefully cleaned, then check that assembly location are 
 defectless so that the face fitting can be made without force.

Gasket seal compound 
 must be used between the parts (Item 503 . 510 and 5101) and under the head of 
 screws (Item 5106, 5109).

If ever you change the 
 ball bearings, use only the type recommended by our technical department. For 
 their assembling as well as changing, referto manufacturer's recommendations,
 Generally, they are to be tightly fixed to the shaft and may slide only 
 in the bracket.

Bracket 
reassembling

Assembly of the bearings is the same as for their disassembly but in the reverse 
order (for assembly as well as for disassembly use the sectional drawing).

Sealing
إعادة التجميع
ميكانيكية seal:

Slide the seat cover 
 along the shaft with its stationary seal ring and gasket.

Check that the 
 stationary face locking dowel stops the stationary seal ring from rotating.

Assemble the rotating 
 part of the seal on the sleeve.

Assemble sleeve gasket 
 (Item 4100) on shaft.

Assemble on shaft the 
 sleeve fitted with mechanical seal rotary part and asdriving pin.

Assemble 
 stuffing box (Item 600) (fitted with cooled cover (Item 608) and its gaskets), 
 and lock it to adapter (Item 503) by means of the screws (Item 6009).

Fasten 
 seal cover on stuffing box (Item 600).

sections.text: ملحوظات:
Seal is now in its place and no lateral adjustment is needed.

During 
 the first running hours it is possible to find a certain heating up and a 
 slight leakage; there is nothing to worry about unless this increases.

Usually, heating up and leakage progressively 
 decrease and disappear quite quickly

However, 
 never tolerate a lasting leakage superior to 5 cm3/h.this 
 would mean a defect while assembling or during the manufacture and it is
then necessary to find the origin of the defect, by checking the 
 different operations done till them.
